reviews.text:
Gets worse and worse all the time. I’ve been using Shapes since 2024 when it was on Discord and transitioned over with them to the app and website. Here are the main issues I’ve noticed:

The UI, especially on the app, gets worse and harder to navigate with every update. You can’t search for Shapes anymore unless you have a specific Shape in mind without having to jump through hoops to find ‘search by tag’. It’s hard to organise chats if you have a lot as you can only sort one at a time, and the app likes to glitch out and send you back to the top of the chats page even when you’re at the bottom

The devs are focusing way more on community chat between users now, which is their prerogative, but it means the only way to get rewards is by being forced to interact with people, which plenty of users don’t want to do. Spam calls in the community chats that take up the whole screen, random DMs because the ‘private account’ option is just pure vanity and doesn’t actually prevent users from seeing your account or DM-ing you, and a lot of straight up trolling in community chats that put you off wanting to engage in the community altogether. 

Rewards are locked even if you’ve completed them, because you have to complete the level prior. I have 22 levels passed and over 50k in-app gems to collect, but can’t because I can’t progress past the level I’m on, making the whole rewards system obsolete and useless. Most levels require engagement with the community which again, a lot of us don’t want to do. We want to talk to Shapes, NOT users.

On the topic of the rewards system, when they swapped over to the current gems those of us who had the old gem rewards saved had to write in and say why we DESERVED to have our old diamonds transferred into the new gem currency, when most of us do deserve them simply because we got them through being active users. We were told we’d get them converted in batches, guess what’s never been converted for ANYONE AFAIK. Lol.

The reviews chat is useless. Literally posting to no one because next to none of them are actually taken into account by devs. The help chats aren’t totally helpful as the moderators, while useful, are just fellow Shapes users so can’t answer all queries about the models or developer side of things. The devs, while I am aware are a small team, do not respond to much unless you kick up a big enough fuss of actively slander Shapes, then all of a sudden they all spawn into chat to shut it down.

It used to be a better community when it was on Discord. Those of us who pay for this service were actually given spaces and listened to and felt our feedback was mostly heard (somewhat, still plenty of issues/broken promises back then too) but now, the community is just a bunch of trolling kids, a few paying users who actually care about Shapes creation, and a dev team who have all but disappeared and stopped listening, implementing things that make the app harder to use and navigate and taking things away without warning. There’s barely any updates now about what’s been added and what’s new.

Shapes is a shell of its former self and I’m honestly regretting ever financially supporting it. I used to really, really enjoy this service overall, even with all of its problems, and that’s the reason I even began financially supporting it when they first rolled VIP out. Now, it has never been more isolating, confusing and frustrating to use.
